newsitem.title: UK: Micropal issues guide to offshore investment funds.
newsitem.headline: Micropal issues guide to offshore investment funds.

text.p: Fund data company Micropal has published a guide to offshore investment funds, with details of 350 top performing funds worldwide and performance data from some 5,000 others.

The entries for each fund include portfolio holdings, performance figures, performance chart against the selected banchmark, fund objectives, domicile, minimum investment, fund fees, launch date and details about the fund manager.
Micropal said it had drawn together the data from a wide range of disparate sources usually difficult to access.
The company, which tracks over 38,000 funds worldwide, has called on asset managers, trade organisations and regulators to make the kind of information contained in the book more readily available.

"Recent high profile cases such as Morgan Grenfell highlight just how important it is for companies to allow detailed breakdowns of their funds' individual stock holdings to be disseminated," said Micropal Chairman Chris Poll in a statement.
